meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts token usage ~75% by dropping filler, articles, and pleasantries while keeping full technical accuracy. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 压缩对话内容,减少约75%的token消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望减少AI对话中的冗余文字,节省token费用
copy.tagline_en: Compress conversation, reduce token usage by ~75%
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to cut filler words and save tokens in AI conversations

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会改用极简的“穴居人”风格回复：去掉冠词、客套话和废话，保留全部技术细节。句子简短，用箭头表示因果关系，一个词能说清就不多说。
howto.when: 当你说“caveman mode”、“talk like caveman”、“use caveman”、“less tokens”、“be brief”或输入“/caveman”时触发。

say.text: 用 caveman 模式解释 React 为什么重新渲染。
say.note: Claude 会给出极简的技术解释。

say.text: caveman mode，告诉我数据库连接池是什么。
say.note: Claude 会以简短片段回答。

say.text: talk like caveman，怎么修复这个 bug？
say.note: Claude 会省略客套，直接给出修复步骤。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude responds in ultra-compressed 'caveman' style: drops articles, filler, and pleasantries while keeping full technical accuracy. Uses short sentences, arrows for causality, and one word when enough.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'caveman mode', 'talk like caveman', 'use caveman', 'less tokens', 'be brief', or invoke '/caveman'.

say_en.text: Use caveman mode to explain why React re-renders.
say_en.note: Claude gives a terse technical explanation.

say_en.text: Caveman mode, what is database connection pooling?
Talk like caveman, how to fix this bug?
say_en.note: Claude skips pleasantries and gives direct fix.
